scripts.build: npm run build -w @samagama/shared && npm run build -w @samagama/server && npm run build -w @samagama/client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @samagama/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w @samagama/server" "npm run dev -w @samagama/client"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @samagama/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @samagama/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
